messages:
Elena: Quick sync 1: packaging the 'consumer-kits' terraform bundle for cloud partner onramp. Need a lightweight ref-arch + module set that SIs can fork.
Tom: Nice. What's the minimum we want in v0?
Elena: v0: networking module, compute module (abstracted names), example overlay for Dedicated + Hosted, README, and a simple smoke script. No provider-specific names.
Priya: Please include a manifest + changelog. Marketplace requires metadata. Also add a short dataflow paragraph for legal.
Omar: Agree on manifest. Suggest fields: id, version, short_desc, supported_deployments, tf_required, provider_lock (sha), smoke_test_cmd.
Elena: Good list. I'll draft manifest.json and a sample smoke output.
Tom: For modules: use namespace rwd-marketplace/partner-consumer and keep example inputs minimal. Avoid 'gke' or vendor tokens in public examples.
Priya: Add a section for Private customers: KMS/HSM integration and key rotation example.
Elena: Will do. Also adding a preflight script `scripts/check_env.sh` that validates terraform version and provider plugin.
BuildBot: CI triggered for branch consumer-kits/v0.1 -> tf-fmt -> tflint -> tfsec -> smoke (ephemeral infra). ETA 6m.
Omar: Can we include two profiles in README: cost-optimized and dev-faststart? Example configs make onboarding smoother.
Elena: Yep. Example snippet for cost-optimized:
```
module "compute" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/rwd-marketplace-partner-consumer.git//modules/compute"
  instance_profile = "small-quantized"
  model_variant = "rwd-llm-small-q4_0"
}
```
Priya: Also include least-privilege IAM snippets and an example policy for logging-only access.
Tom: Add a short troubleshooting section for common terraform provider mismatches + recommended lockfile generation command. We ran into this with ACME partner.
Elena: Adding `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` example and notes.
BuildBot: Smoke job #10112 started -> applied ephemeral infra -> ran sample inference -> teardown.
BuildBot: Smoke job #10112 SUCCESS. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/10112/quickrun.txt
PublishBot: Reminder: marketplace bundle needs 1) 2-page support doc, 2) arch diagram PNG, 3) security checklist. Link: https://wiki.redwood/marketplace-guidelines
Omar: I'll draft the arch diagram (SVG + PNG) and the SI playbook checklist (how to run the quicklab and validate).
Priya: I'll own the security checklist and the KMS notes. Elena, ping me when manifest is ready for review.
Elena: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-consumer-kits/pull/12 (manifest + modules + smoke). PTAL and drop approvals if green.
Tom: If we're green by EOD, can we schedule a partner tech walkthrough next Thurs 11am PT?
Elena: Tentatively booked. Will confirm after PR merge. :thumbsup:
